confound_explanation: The 0/4 headline is weaker than S3C's 0/16 and the difference is worth naming. case-51 does not reach `eligible` even clean, because the frozen §6.1 P1 rule sends it to manual_review. So 0/4 cannot be read as evidence that the Gate survives poisoning of this success: the Gate was never going to admit it. With integrity forced True, PZ2 is held by that same P1 reason and produces no anomaly at all -- its rejection is a property of case-51, not a defence against misbinding. PZ1/PZ3/PZ4 are caught by the anomaly layer independently. S3C's 0/16 remains the poison-resistance result; this one is a robustness check whose confound is reported rather than absorbed.
